Observed beaks, feet and leaf features using descriptive words.
Linked beak and foot shapes to bird food and movement in 4/4 attempts.
Described a long, sharp beak for catching fish and webbed feet for swimming.
Teach-back was not completed successfully; feature description was practised once without an unaided correct response.
end.parentNote: Atharv practised observing plant and animal features and explaining how a bird’s beak or feet help it. They used the method of looking closely, naming the feature, and linking it to eating or movement; all four such links were correct without help. At home, ask them to observe one bird or leaf and say two features and what each feature helps it do.
